request.raw_text: Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.

areas_to_change.action: Create a rounded-rectangle opening or recessed pocket, nominally 20 cm wide by 10 cm high and 3 cm deep, with 1 cm corner radii.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The large, plain rear housing panel of the coffee machine.
areas_to_change.location: On the lower portion of the -Y rear face, horizontally centered between the left and right sides and placed with approximately balanced clearance to the bottom and side boundaries.
areas_to_change.description: Remove material inward from the rear panel using a horizontally oriented rounded-rectangle profile. The resulting feature is intended as a draft mounting or access location for a power plug connection and main ON/OFF switch.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Front operating face and dispensing bay
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the control dial, indicators, coffee outlet, steam wand, cup platform, and surrounding front housing without modification.
Preserve the external casing contours, seams, handle-like rear detail, top trim, and side openings.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Rear panel outside the new opening
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Retain the existing rear surface, edge fillets, panel boundaries, and wall continuity everywhere outside the rounded-rectangle feature.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Bottom base, feet, and corner structures
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Maintain the base rail, feet, lower corner radii, and sufficient material clearance around the new opening.
Avoid intersecting internal mechanisms or structural supports unless relocation is explicitly required.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A horizontally oriented 200 mm by 100 mm rounded-rectangle cut or recess, 30 mm deep, with four 10 mm-radius corners in the lower rear casing.
predicted_final_outcome.function: Provides a preliminary access or mounting region for a power plug interface and the machine's main ON/OFF switch.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The feature creates a localized rear-facing cavity or opening while leaving the machine's overall envelope, support, controls, and dispensing functions unchanged.

ambiguities.description: The word "opening" can mean either a through-cut or a blind recessed pocket, while the specified 3 cm depth suggests a blind pocket.
candidate_interpretations: Create a blind rounded-rectangle pocket exactly 30 mm deep.
Create a through-opening, using 30 mm as the intended passage or enclosure depth.
Create a 30 mm-deep recessed mounting cavity with a thinner through-cut at its back.

ambiguities.description: The orientation of the 20 cm by 10 cm dimensions is not explicitly stated.
candidate_interpretations: Use 20 cm horizontally and 10 cm vertically.
Use 10 cm horizontally and 20 cm vertically.

ambiguities.description: "More or less equally distanced from bottom and sides" does not define exact offsets and may conflict with the available rear-panel proportions.
candidate_interpretations: Center the opening horizontally and make its bottom clearance approximately equal to each side clearance.
Center the opening within the lower half of the rear panel.
Use equal left and right margins while selecting a practical lower vertical offset.

ambiguities.description: The exact rear-panel wall thickness and internal component clearances are not visible in the supplied exterior views.
candidate_interpretations: Apply the full 30 mm depth if internal clearance permits.
Limit the depth to avoid internal interference.
Modify internal supports locally to accommodate the requested depth.
